_about: The 1971/73 accent mini-reform: Lei 5.765 de 18-12-1971 (Brazil) and Decreto-Lei 32/73 de 6-2-1973 (Portugal). The two norms did DIFFERENT things and this file must be applied per-variant: (1) abolition of the differential circumflex on a closed list of homographs (the 'differential' map below) — this was Brazil's 1971 change; PORTUGAL had already dropped these in the 1945 Convencao (Base XXII), so the differential map applies on the BR 1943->1971 edge only, not on the PT 1945->1973 edge; (2) abolition of the grave/circumflex accent on subtonic syllables of derived words (-mente, -zinho, ...), handled by a regex in rules.py (strip a grave accent on e/i/o/u that is not the crasis 'a') — this was the substance of the Portuguese 1973 decree and applies on both lines. The base PT/BR divergences (facto/fato, Antonio/Antonio) are untouched.
_subtonic_note: Grave-accented subtonic vowels existed in pre-1971 spellings such as 'somente'<-'sòmente', 'sozinho'<-'sòzinho', 'cafezinho'<-'cafèzinho', 'unicamente'<-'ùnicamente'. Removal is a clean rule (strip grave accent on e/i/o/u, never on crasis 'a'/'as'), so no exhaustive list is stored.
_kept_note: Several differential accents survived 1971/73 and were only abolished by AO1990 (see differential_accents.json): pára, pélo/pêlo, pólo, pêra. The verbal/grammatical pairs pôde/pode and pôr/por survive AO1990 too.
